settings.description: Keep an ability button when the selected squads have more than one ability for it. The game shows one ability per button (F1-F4) and empties the button when a selection has two of them, such as mines and C4 on F2. With this, the button shows one of them, and pressing it opens a row of all of them over the order panel; pick one with the order key above it (Q, R, F or G with the default keys) or with the mouse, or press the ability key again to close the row. The button then shows the ability last picked. Experimental. Restart required.
